We need answer with a single fenced ST block containing contract comment and implementation. Need implement FB. Need understand requirements.

We have inputs: bottleSensor, cleaningConfirmButton, fillingConfirmButton, cappingConfirmButton, packingConfirmButton, finishedButton. Outputs: Pump_Motor, Filling_Valve, Capping_Machine, Packing_Machine, Completion_Light.

Task: automated filling line. Each step triggered and continues? Wording:
- When sensor detects bottle, triggers start of cleaning pump and continues to work.
- After cleaning completed, operator operates cleaningConfirmButton to trigger cleaning completion signal, automatically starting filling valve for filling.
- After filling completed, operator presses fillingConfirmButton to trigger filling completion signal, automatically starting capping machine for capping.
- After capping completed, operator presses cappingConfirmButton to trigger capping completion signal, starting packing machine for packaging.
- After packaging completed, operator presses packingConfirmButton to trigger packaging completion signal, lighting up packaging completion indicator light.
- After operator picks up packaged bottle, they press finishedButton to reset indicator light and prepare for next bottle's production cycle.

Need decide state machine. It seems cleaning starts when bottleSensor detects a bottle and continues to work. Does cleaning pump continue until cleaning confirmation? Likely yes. When sensor detects bottle, Pump_Motor = true. When cleaningConfirmButton pressed, cleaning complete, start Filling_Valve for filling. Does Pump_Motor turn off when cleaning confirmed? Probably yes cleaning done, pump off. Filling starts. When fillingConfirmButton pressed, Filling_Valve off, Capping_Machine on. Then cappingConfirm -> capping off, packing on. packingConfirm -> packing off, Completion_Light on. finished -> light off, back to idle.

Need also think if bottleSensor should be a pulse? "When sensor bottleSensor detects a bottle, it triggers the start of cleaning pump and continues to work." Could be level high while bottle present. But then if sensor drops before cleaning confirm, what? The line likely sensor edge? It says detects bottle, triggers start. We can use rising edge? But requirement says "when sensor detects a bottle, it triggers start" not necessarily edge, but in physical system sensor may remain true while bottle at cleaning station. Since operator confirms cleaning completion later, sensor may still be true. If we start pump when bottleSensor true and then when cleaningConfirmButton true transition to filling even while bottleSensor true? Need avoid oscillation? If state is Cleaning, pump on; when cleaningConfirm pressed, go Filling and pump off, filling valve on. But if bottleSensor still true, condition not re-trigger unless state machine? If we implement in idle only start on sensor true, then after finished return idle, if sensor still true maybe would start immediately next cycle? But bottle sensor may still be true until bottle moves. Requirement says after finishedButton reset and prepare for next bottle's production cycle. We should likely use edge detection for bottleSensor to start cycle, not level, to avoid immediate retrigger when finished pressed while sensor still true? But operator picks up packaged bottle, finishedButton pressed. The bottle sensor probably no longer true because bottle has moved through line and picked up. But not guaranteed. To be safe, use R_TRIG on bottleSensor at idle? Or maybe state machine with idle waiting for sensor rising edge. The requirement "When sensor bottleSensor detects a bottle, it triggers the start..." Typically detect rising edge. We can implement edge-triggered in idle state.

Similarly confirmation buttons: "operator operates button" could be rising edge. Need avoid holding button causing transitioning multiple steps? Since state machine only transitions on that state, holding button might no issue. But if one button pressed at wrong state? Ignore.

- Filling_Valve := (state = Filling)

- Packing_Machine := (state = Packing)

- Cleaning -> Filling on rising edge cleaningConfirmButton? ELSIF state=Cleaning AND cleaningEdge THEN... etc. Then state updated once. If multiple edges in same scan, only first matching state transition occurs. That's acceptable? Need also consider edge detection for bottleSensor. Use R_TRIG. For confirmation buttons, we can also use R_TRIG to detect presses. But if we use ELSIF only one. Need contract comment. Need include activation, retention/hold, explicit reset, same-scan priority, units/boundaries, cite PUB IDs. Let's draft concise:

(*
ENGINEERING_CONTRACT
- Pump_Motor: activated in state Cleaning on bottleSensor true from Idle. Retained until cleaningConfirmButton true (PUB001-PUB003).
- Filling_Valve: activated when Cleaning -> Filling on cleaningConfirmButton true; retained until fillingConfirmButton true (PUB003-PUB004).
- Capping_Machine: activated when Filling -> Capping on fillingConfirmButton true; retained until cappingConfirmButton true (PUB004-PUB005).
- Packing_Machine: activated when Capping -> Packing on cappingConfirmButton true; retained until packingConfirmButton true (PUB005-PUB006).
- Completion_Light: activated when Packing -> Done on packingConfirmButton true; retained until finishedButton true (PUB006-PUB007).
- Same-scan priority: single transition evaluated by current state in IF/ELSIF; outputs reflect new state; simultaneous eligible inputs in different states not possible due to mutually exclusive state, earliest matching transition only.
- Units: BOOL states, no time units; state integer constants 0..5.
*)

IF state = ST_IDLE THEN
    IF bottleSensor THEN
        state := ST_CLEANING;
    END_IF;
ELSIF state = ST_CLEANING THEN
    IF cleaningConfirmButton THEN
        state := ST_FILLING;
    END_IF;
ELSIF state = ST_FILLING THEN
    IF fillingConfirmButton THEN
        state := ST_CAPPING;
    END_IF;
ELSIF state = ST_CAPPING THEN
    IF cappingConfirmButton THEN
        state := ST_PACKING;
    END_IF;
ELSIF state = ST_PACKING THEN
    IF packingConfirmButton THEN
        state := ST_DONE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF state = ST_DONE THEN
    IF finishedButton THEN
        state := ST_IDLE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

Pump_Motor := (state = ST_CLEANING);
Filling_Valve := (state = ST_FILLING);
Capping_Machine := (state = ST_CAPPING);
Packing_Machine := (state = ST_PACKING);
